page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 server instance running on KVM hypervisors. It features 40 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 20 physical cores using hyperthreading, powered by a 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. The system includes 192.0 GB of memory, yielding 4.8 GB per physical core. The instance operates without local attached storage and contains zero dedicated GPUs. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the CPU multi-core performance within the average tier across tested cloud hardware, achieving a multi-core score of 38,378.07 in stress-ng and 12,045.0 in Geekbench. Uncached memory read bandwidth measures 108.89 GB/sec with write throughput at 48.09 GB/sec. Operational benchmarks show a PassMark database score of 14,249.04 and Redis SET performance reaching 34.78 million operations per second. Static web serving throughput reaches 25.35 GB/sec. For artificial intelligence workloads, the instance handles small 135M parameter LLM model generation at 76.66 tokens per second, decreasing to 12.71 tokens per second on medium 7B models. The lack of local SSD storage requires reliance on remote block storage for persistent data.

The server offers a balanced allocation of processing power and memory capacity suitable for general compute workloads. Without local disks or dedicated GPU hardware, compute density is concentrated on core execution and system memory. This resource profile fits multi-threaded web application hosting, software compilation, database caching using Redis, and lightweight natural language processing tasks.
